newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 1.87 million barrels in the week ended April 25 to 314.67 million barrels from 312.79 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 3.42 million barrels in the week to 252.24 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 1.41 million barrels to 94.89 million barrels from 96.30 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.05 million barrels to 30.09 million barrels.
It said gasoline production fell 10,000 barrels in the week to 7.73 million bpd from 7.74 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 408,000 barrels to 194.18 million barrels, from 194.59 million barrels the previous week.
Percent of stocks capacity was unchanged at 93.5 percent from the previous week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.64 million barrels to 34.12 million barrels from 35.77 million barrels the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units were unchanged at 14.28 million barrels from the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 42.28 million barrels from 41.60 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.983 million barrels per day from 7.984 million, API said.
